description: Fetch the full DESIGN.md for one theme: semantic colour roles, the complete shadcn token set in light and dark, typography, radius, spacing, MEASURED WCAG contrast ratios, and numbered rules the generated UI must follow. Read this before writing any UI. Save it at the repo root as DESIGN.md so it applies to every session.
